lines.text: David waited patiently, and the LORD heard his cry and set his feet upon a rock.
The LORD put a new song in David's mouth, and many will see, fear, and trust the LORD.
God did not require burnt offerings or sin offerings, but opened David's ears, and His law was in David's heart.
Evils without number surround David, and his sins are more than the sand of the sea.
David asks that all who seek the LORD rejoice, and he calls God his shepherd and deliverer.
